description: This file defines custom exception classes for the FastAPI framework, including HTTP and WebSocket exceptions, error models, and various validation error classes. It also imports relevant external dependencies and provides example usage in docstrings.

classes.name: HTTPException
classes.description: A custom HTTP exception class extending Starlette's HTTPException, used to send HTTP errors with additional annotations.

classes.name: WebSocketException
classes.description: A custom WebSocket exception class extending Starlette's WebSocketException, used for WebSocket error handling.

classes.name: FastAPIError
classes.description: A base class for FastAPI-specific runtime errors.

classes.name: DependencyScopeError
classes.description: Represents an error where dependency scope is improperly declared, extending FastAPIError.

classes.name: ValidationException
classes.description: Base class for validation-related exceptions, capturing error details and endpoint context.

classes.name: RequestValidationError
classes.description: A specific validation exception for request errors, extending ValidationException.

classes.name: WebSocketRequestValidationError
classes.description: Validation error for WebSocket requests, extending ValidationException.

classes.name: ResponseValidationError
classes.description: Validation error related to responses, extending ValidationException.

classes.name: PydanticV1NotSupportedError
classes.description: Error class indicating usage of unsupported Pydantic v1 models.

classes.name: FastAPIDeprecationWarning
classes.description: Custom warning class for deprecation notices within FastAPI.
